item.title: Bulletin updated at 18:50 HKT 19/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a trough of low pressure, there will be heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. The trough of low pressure is expected to depart slightly from the coast of Guangdong midweek this week, lingering over the northern part of the South China Sea. There will still be showers over the coastal areas. An upper-air disturbance will affect southern China towards the weekend.

Date/Month: 20/05 (Monday)
Wind: East to southeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Cloudy with showers and a few squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times.
Temp range: 23 - 26 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
